1: # Tasks — Idempotent OCI model deployment
2: 
3: > Fresh branch off `main`. The abandoned `refactor/simplify-model-deployment`
4: > manifest work (and the cross-language `manifest_schema.py` / schema-parity guard
5: > it described) is **not** present here and is not carried over. Packaging follows
6: > Docker's "OCI artifacts for AI model packaging" strategy: OCI artifact + typed
7: > config blob + per-file uncompressed content-addressed blobs.
8: 
9: ## 0. Confirm before building the cache path
10: 
11: - [x] 0.1 Confirm per-model `version` = **content-derived sha256** of the model
12:       dir (design Decision 4). Confirms existing `…/v1/…` keys are intentionally
13:       reset (safe pre-prod; no warm cache).
14: 
15: ## 1. Local build script (producer)
16: 
17: - [x] 1.1 Assemble the complete `/models` tree from `model-repository/` + local
18:       ONNX weights; stage `_envs/cpu_py312.tar.gz`.
19: - [x] 1.2 Build the conda env in a **`linux/amd64` Docker stage** (micromamba +
20:       conda-pack, relocated from `Dockerfile.init`) so it is correct + reproducible
21:       on arm64 build hosts (Mac M4). Cache the produced tarball.
22: - [x] 1.3 Run `onnx.checker` at build time over ONNX models; fail the build on
23:       structural errors (was runtime in `init_models.py`).
24: - [x] 1.4 Derive per-model `version = sha256(model_dir)` (Decision 4) and assemble
25:       the inventory **config blob** (`triton`/`id`/`role`/`version`; `internal`
26:       omits `id`) with custom mediaType
27:       (`application/vnd.protifer.model-inventory.v1+json`).
28: - [x] 1.5 `oras push` to `ghcr.io/<org>/model-repo` as **per-file uncompressed
29:       blobs** (oras native multi-file layout; path in the title annotation) + the
30:       config blob. No whole-tree tar, no gzip on weights — determinism is
31:       intrinsic per Decision 1b.
32: - [x] 1.6 Emit the immutable digest for the deploy repo to pin.
33: - [x] 1.7 Strip `scripts/build-model-archives.py`: drop sidecars and GitHub-Release
34:       asset orchestration; the deterministic-tar dance is superseded by per-file
35:       content addressing (not preserved — no tar to make deterministic).
36: 
37: ## 2. Thin init + serving
38: 
39: > The **prod** `model-init`/Triton wiring is deploy-repo-owned (contract below);
40: > the monorepo realizes it only in the dev `cpu-triton` profile and deletes the
41: > old init code. Do **not** add prod stack files, org names, or digests here.
42: 
43: - [x] 2.1 (deploy contract — document, don't implement in monorepo) `model-init`
44:       one-shot = **stock public `oras` image** running `oras pull $MODEL_ARTIFACT_REF`
45:       into a fresh dir + atomic repoint to Triton's `--model-repository` target
46:       (full replacement). No custom init image, no ONNX/conda runtime deps.
47: - [x] 2.2 (deploy contract — document, don't implement in monorepo) Triton runs
48:       `--model-control-mode=none` with init-completion gating startup
49:       (`depends_on: { model-init: service_completed_successfully }`); the
50:       `--load-model` list is gone (artifact is the served set).
51: - [x] 2.3 Realize 2.1/2.2 in the monorepo **dev `cpu-triton` profile only**
52:       (see 6.2).
53: - [x] 2.4 Delete `infra/triton/init_models.py` entirely and the standalone runtime
54:       `infra/triton/Dockerfile.init`.
55: 
56: ## 3. Remove the GitHub-Releases distribution surface
57: 
58: - [x] 3.1 Remove the `MODEL_MANIFEST_URL` distribution path from
59:       `.github/workflows/triton-ci.yml`.
60: - [x] 3.2 Rework/remove `infra/triton/tests/triton_ready_check.py` and
61:       `smoke_manifest_download.py` (they read the model list from
62:       `MODEL_MANIFEST_URL`).
63: - [x] 3.3 Remove the manifest-resolution tests in `infra/triton/tests/test_manifest.py`
64:       tied to URL/PATH resolution and `.installed-sha256` markers.
65: - [x] 3.4 Remove sha256 sidecar/inline-hash logic superseded by OCI digests.
66: - [x] 3.5 Keep a **lightweight CI guard** over checked-in `model-repository/`
67:       configs (ensemble steps present + pbtxt layout) — replaces the `onnx.checker`
68:       / completeness enforcement that moved local (Decision 7). Confirm `model-guards.yml`
69:       retains the archive-determinism/layout sentinels that still apply; drop only
70:       the manifest-parity step that no longer has a manifest to check.
71: 
72: ## 4. Gateway — inventory from artifact config blob
73: 
74: - [x] 4.1 `packages/shared`: Zod inventory schema + reader over the OCI config blob
75:       (`oras manifest fetch-config` / registry GET); checked-in file-source fallback
76:       for dev.
77: - [x] 4.2 `config/schema.ts`: add `MODEL_ARTIFACT_REF` (the digest, shared with
78:       init per C1) + inventory source; retire `MODELS_VERSION`.
79: - [x] 4.3 `config/suites.ts`: build `PredictionSuiteConfig` from inventory (filter
80:       `role != internal`); map `id`→`triton`; fail fast at boot on unknown `id` and
81:       on unreachable config (loud, no stale fallback).
82: - [x] 4.4 Cache version source flip: `suites.ts` reads each model's own `version`
83:       from inventory (per-model) instead of the shared `MODELS_VERSION`. **`hash.ts`
84:       is untouched** — the `emb/{name}/{version}/{hash}` format already exists
85:       (Decision 4).
86: - [x] 4.5 Update `suites.test.ts` (drop the `MODELS_VERSION`-applies-to-all test);
87:       add the unknown-`id` guard test and a per-model-version flow test.
88: 
89: ## 5. Wire-version sever (carried into this change)
90: 
91: - [x] 5.1 `embedding-worker/processor.ts`: omit `model_version` (Triton `latest`).
92:       Required: content-derived versions are non-numeric and Triton rejects them as
93:       a wire `model_version`.
94: - [x] 5.2 Real-Triton-shaped mock test rejecting non-numeric `model_version`; assert
95:       both worker paths pass; confirm prediction adapters already omit it (verified:
96:       no `model_version` in dispatch/adapters).
97: 
98: ## 6. Dev + deploy wiring
99: 
100: - [x] 6.1 Checked-in dev inventory file; gateway reads it as the config-blob
101:       equivalent (mock-triton path unchanged, no `oras pull` in default dev).
102: - [x] 6.2 Dev `docker-compose*.yml` **only**: opt-in `cpu-triton` profile that
103:       `oras pull`s from a _local_ registry, init→triton ordering,
104:       `--model-control-mode=none`. Use a placeholder `MODEL_ARTIFACT_REF` (local
105:       registry / `<org>`); no prod org, host, or digest in the monorepo. Prod
106:       compose stays in the deploy repos.
107: - [x] 6.3 Copy `infra/.env.dev` into this worktree before bringing the stack up
108:       (currently absent — `test:int` blocked until present).
109: - [x] 6.4 Hand off two items to the deploy-repo runbook (note only, no values
110:       here): GHCR retention (keep last N + pinned prod) and the gateway's GHCR
111:       read credential. The C1 same-digest invariant (gateway + init share one
112:       `MODEL_ARTIFACT_REF`) is part of this hand-off.
113: 
114: ## 8. Fix artifact layout — env split + empty version dirs (Decision 8)
115: 
116: > Found while booting Triton from a real pulled artifact: `_envs/` polled as a
117: > model (fatal under `--exit-on-error`, defaults true) and empty ensemble version
118: > dirs dropped by the OCI round-trip. Corrects work checked off in §1.
119: 
120: - [x] 8.1 `build-model-artifact.py`: stage configs under `staging/models/` and the
121:       conda env under `staging/envs/cpu_py312.tar.gz` (was `staging/_envs/…`).
122:       Update `model_dirs()`, `build_inventory()` (drop the now-dead `_envs` skip),
123:       `check_onnx()`, and `collect_blobs()` to walk the `models/` subtree.
124: - [x] 8.2 `build-model-artifact.py`: for every ensemble (`platform: "ensemble"`)
125:       model dir, materialize a carried, byte-stable `.keep` placeholder (0 bytes,
126:       fixed name) in its numeric version dir so oras carries the otherwise-empty
127:       directory; remove `.keep` from any exclude set. (`.gitkeep` in the source
128:       tree stays for git but stays excluded — the build guarantees the dir, so a
129:       new ensemble can't silently lose its version dir.) Note: `model_dir_version`
130:       hashes all files, so the placeholder enters the ensemble's content version —
131:       keep it deterministic (or exclude it from the hash) so rebuilds are stable.
132: - [x] 8.3 Repoint the 3 python `config.pbtxt` (`_internal_prott5_tokenizer`,
133:       `_tmbed_viterbi`, deferred `_internal_esm2_tokenizer`) `EXECUTION_ENV_PATH`
134:       to `$$TRITON_MODEL_DIRECTORY/../../envs/cpu_py312.tar.gz` (mount-agnostic).
135: - [x] 8.4 Dev `cpu-triton` profile: `oras pull -o /data`, mount at `/data`,
136:       `--model-repository=/data/models` (was `-o /models` + `/models`). Keep the
137:       `rm -rf` fresh-dir + completion gating.
138: - [x] 8.5 `check-model-repository-layout.py`: confirm it still passes against the
139:       source tree (ensemble version dirs present via `.gitkeep`); no env-path
140:       assertions needed (pbtxt path is relative).
141: - [x] 8.6 Rebuild + push a fresh artifact; boot Triton with the **default**
142:       `--exit-on-error` (true) and confirm all models + ensembles reach READY with
143:       no `_envs`/version-dir errors. Re-pin the new digest. (Verified locally:
144:       real weighted artifact → oras round-trip → cpu-triton boot reaches **22/22
145:       READY, 0 UNAVAILABLE, health 200**, no fatal exit. Required adding
146:       `--disable-auto-complete-config` (configs are strict; the auto-complete stub
147:       otherwise fails to resolve the conda exec env). Prod digest re-pin is the
148:       deploy-repo action.)
149: - [x] 8.7 Hand the layout contract change to the deploy repo (paste, not a
150:       tracked file): `models/`+`envs/` siblings, `-o /data`,
151:       `--model-repository=/data/models`, fresh-digest re-pin.
152: 
153: ## 7. Quality gates
154: 
155: - [x] 7.1 `bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format && bun run test`
156: - [x] 7.2 `bun run test:int` (stack up) — pipeline caches/keys by per-model version
157:       (verified via CI "Backend E2E" job, green on PR #5).
158: - [x] 7.3 Python guard suite green after removals
159: - [x] 7.4 `bun run build`
160: - [x] 7.5 Manual: dedup drill — change one model, rebuild+push, confirm only that
161:       model's blobs transfer (unchanged blobs skipped). (Verified: changing one
162:       config made B's push upload only that file + the tiny inventory blob; 194
163:       blobs skipped as `Exists`, zero `.onnx` re-transferred.)
164: - [x] 7.6 Manual: rollback drill — deploy A, deploy B, repin A's digest, confirm
165:       `/models` == A with no host touch. (Verified: re-pinning A's digest re-pulls
166:       a byte-identical tree; A vs B differ only in the one changed config.)
167: - [x] 7.7 PR; check CI ~5 min after open. (PR #5; all CI checks green incl.
168:       Backend E2E, layout guard, typecheck/lint/test, docker builds.)
